SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS n_orders,
       MIN(o.order_ts_utc) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) AS max_ts
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT o.web_order_id, o.status, o.order_ts_utc, o.login_state, o.line_count, o.order_total_gross,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
         WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') AS test_lines,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) AS all_lines
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE o.web_order_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
   AND CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT o.status,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
                             WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_with_test_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
                             WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND s.store_id=999) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_in_999,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_without_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helsinki_same_day
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(o.order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helsinki_day_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
